name: pairwise_fin_succ_iff
statement:
theorem pairwise_fin_succ_iff {n : ℕ} {R : Fin n.succ → Fin n.succ → Prop} :
    Pairwise R ↔
      (∀ i, R (Fin.succ i) 0) ∧ (∀ j, R 0 (Fin.succ j)) ∧
      Pairwise fun i j => R (Fin.succ i) (Fin.succ j) where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨
    fun _ => h (Fin.succ_ne_zero _), fun _ => h (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm,
    fun _i _j hij => h <| Fin.succ_inj.not.2 hij⟩
  mpr
  | ⟨hi, hj, h⟩ =>
    Fin.cases
      (Fin.cases nofun fun j _ => hj j)
      (fun i => Fin.cases (fun _ => hi i) fun _j hij => h (ne_of_apply_ne _ hij))

  simp only [pairwise_fin_succ_iff, comm (b := 0) (r := R), and_self_left]

theorem head_induction_on {motive : ∀ a : α, ReflTransGen r a b → Prop} {a : α}

    (head : ∀ {a c} (h' : r a c) (h : ReflTransGen r c b), motive c h → motive a (h.head h')) :
    motive a h
proof:
:= by
  induction h with

    (single : ∀ {a b} (h : r a b), motive (single h))
    (trans : ∀ {a b c} (h₁ : ReflTransGen r a b) (h₂ : ReflTransGen r b c), motive h₁ → motive h₂ →
      motive (h₁.trans h₂)) : motive h
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact refl a
  | tail hab hbc ih => exact trans hab (.single hbc) ih (single hbc)

statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem head_induction_on {motive : ∀ a : α, TransGen r a b → Prop} {a : α} (h : TransGen r a b)
    (single : ∀ {a} (h : r a b), motive a (single h))

  induction h with

  | tail hab hbc h_ih => exact trans hab (.single hbc) h_ih (single hbc)

lemma eqvGen_le {r r' : α → α → Prop} [IsEquiv α r'] (h : r ≤ r') : EqvGen r ≤ r'

  | _, _, .symm _ _ hxy => _root_.symm (eqvGen_le h _ _ hxy)
  | _, _, .trans _ _ _ hxy hyz => _root_.trans (eqvGen_le h _ _ hxy) (eqvGen_le h _ _ hyz)
  | _, _, .rel _ _ hab => h _ _ hab

  | _, _, .trans _ _ _ hxy hyz => .trans _ _ _ (eqvGen_mono h _ _ hxy) (eqvGen_mono h _ _ hyz)

name: church_rosser
statement:
theorem church_rosser (h : ∀ a b c, r a b → r a c → ∃ d, ReflGen r b d ∧ ReflTransGen r c d)
    (hab : ReflTransGen r a b) (hac : ReflTransGen r a c) : Join (ReflTransGen r) b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hab with
  | refl => exact ⟨c, hac, refl⟩
  | @tail d e _ hde ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨b, hdb, hcb⟩
    have : ∃ a, ReflTransGen r e a ∧ ReflGen r b a := by
      clear hcb
      induction hdb with
      | refl => exact ⟨e, refl, ReflGen.single hde⟩
      | @tail f b _ hfb ih =>
        rcases ih with ⟨a, hea, hfa⟩
        cases hfa with
        | refl => exact ⟨b, hea.tail hfb, ReflGen.refl⟩
        | single hfa =>
          rcases h _ _ _ hfb hfa with ⟨c, hbc, hac⟩
          exact ⟨c, hea.trans hac, hbc⟩
    rcases this with ⟨a, hea, hba⟩
    cases hba with
    | refl => exact ⟨b, hea, hcb⟩
    | single hba => exact ⟨a, hea, hcb.tail hba⟩

name: cutExpand_le_invImage_lex
statement:
theorem cutExpand_le_invImage_lex [DecidableEq α] [Std.Irrefl r] :
    CutExpand r ≤ InvImage (Finsupp.Lex (rᶜ ⊓ (· ≠ ·)) (· < ·)) toFinsupp
proof:
:= by
  rintro s t ⟨u, a, hr, he⟩
  replace hr := fun a' ↦ mt (hr a')
  refine ⟨a, fun b h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp_rw [toFinsupp_apply]
  · apply_fun count b at he
    simpa only [count_add, count_singleton, ite_eq_right h.2, add_zero, count_eq_zero.2 (hr b h.1)]
      using he
  · apply_fun count a at he
    simp only [count_add, count_singleton_self, count_eq_zero.2 (hr _ (irrefl_of r a)),
      add_zero] at he
    exact he ▸ Nat.lt_succ_self _

name: cutExpand_iff
statement:
theorem cutExpand_iff [DecidableEq α] [Std.Irrefl r] {s' s : Multiset α} :
    CutExpand r s' s ↔
      ∃ (t : Multiset α) (a : α), (∀ a' ∈ t, r a' a) ∧ a ∈ s ∧ s' = s.erase a + t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [CutExpand, add_singleton_eq_iff]
  refine exists₂_congr fun t a ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht, ha, rfl⟩
    obtain h | h := mem_add.1 ha
    exacts [⟨ht, h, erase_add_left_pos t h⟩, (@irrefl α r _ a (ht a h)).elim]
  · rintro ⟨ht, h, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨ht, mem_add.2 (Or.inl h), (erase_add_left_pos t h).symm⟩

name: cutExpand_fibration
statement:
theorem cutExpand_fibration (r : α → α → Prop) :
    Fibration (GameAdd (CutExpand r) (CutExpand r)) (CutExpand r) fun s ↦ s.1 + s.2
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨s₁, s₂⟩ s ⟨t, a, hr, he⟩; dsimp at he ⊢
  classical
  obtain ⟨ha, rfl⟩ := add_singleton_eq_iff.1 he
  rw [add_assoc, mem_add] at ha
  obtain h | h := ha
  · refine ⟨(s₁.erase a + t, s₂), GameAdd.fst ⟨t, a, hr, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [add_comm, ← add_assoc, singleton_add, cons_erase h]
    · rw [add_assoc s₁, erase_add_left_pos _ h, add_right_comm, add_assoc]
  · refine ⟨(s₁, (s₂ + t).erase a), GameAdd.snd ⟨t, a, hr, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [add_comm, singleton_add, cons_erase h]
    · rw [add_assoc, erase_add_right_pos _ h]

statement:
lemma cutExpand_closed [Std.Irrefl r] (p : α → Prop)
    (h : ∀ {a' a}, r a' a → p a → p a') {s' s : Multiset α} :
    CutExpand r s' s → (∀ a ∈ s, p a) → ∀ a ∈ s', p a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [cutExpand_iff]
  rintro ⟨t, a, hr, ha, rfl⟩ hsp a' h'
  obtain (h' | h') := mem_add.1 h'
  exacts [hsp a' (mem_of_mem_erase h'), h (hr a' h') (hsp a ha)]

name: acc_of_singleton
statement:
theorem acc_of_singleton [Std.Irrefl r] {s : Multiset α} (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, Acc (CutExpand r) {a}) :
    Acc (CutExpand r) s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => exact Acc.intro 0 fun s h ↦ (not_cutExpand_zero s h).elim
  | cons a s ihs =>
    rw [← s.singleton_add a]
    rw [forall_mem_cons] at hs
    exact (hs.1.prod_gameAdd <| ihs fun a ha ↦ hs.2 a ha).of_fibration _ (cutExpand_fibration r)

name: _root_.Acc.cutExpand
statement: theorem _root_.Acc.cutExpand [Std.Irrefl r] {a : α} (hacc : Acc r a) : Acc (CutExpand r) {a}

  refine Acc.intro _ fun s ↦ ?_
  classical
  simp only [cutExpand_iff, mem_singleton]
  rintro ⟨t, a, hr, rfl, rfl⟩
  refine acc_of_singleton fun a' ↦ ?_
  rw [erase_singleton, zero_add]
  exact ih a' ∘ hr a'

statement:
theorem Perm.exists_extending_pair [Finite α]
    (f g : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    ∃ σ : Perm β, ∀ a, σ (f a) = g a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Finite {x | x ∈ Set.range f} := .of_surjective _ (Set.codRestrict_range_surjective f)
  refine ⟨((Equiv.ofInjective f hf).symm.trans (Equiv.ofInjective g hg)).extendSubtype, ?_⟩
  simp [Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem]

name: Perm.exists_map_finset_eq
statement:
theorem Perm.exists_map_finset_eq
    (s t : Finset β) (h : s.card = t.card) :
    ∃ σ : Perm β, s.map σ.toEmbedding = t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Perm.exists_extending_pair
    (fun x : s => (x : β)) (fun x : s => ((s.equivOfCardEq h) x : β))
    Subtype.val_injective (Subtype.val_injective.comp (s.equivOfCardEq h).injective)
  refine ⟨σ, Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (fun b hb => ?_) (by simp [h])⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hb
  exact (hσ ⟨a, ha⟩) ▸ ((s.equivOfCardEq h) ⟨a, ha⟩).2

statement:
theorem leftInvOn_piecewise {e' : PartialEquiv α β} [∀ i, Decidable (i ∈ s)]
    [∀ i, Decidable (i ∈ t)] (h : e.IsImage s t) (h' : e'.IsImage s t) :
    LeftInvOn (t.piecewise e.symm e'.symm) (s.piecewise e e') (s.ite e.source e'.source)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x (⟨he, hs⟩ | ⟨he, hs : x ∉ s⟩)
  · rw [piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hs, piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ ((h he).2 hs), e.left_inv he]

@[ext]
protected theorem ext {e e' : PartialEquiv α β} (h : ∀ x, e x = e' x)
    (hsymm : ∀ x, e.symm x = e'.symm x) (hs : e.source = e'.source) : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  have A : (e : α → β) = e' := by
    ext x
    exact h x
  have B : (e.symm : β → α) = e'.symm := by
    ext x
    exact hsymm x
  have I : e '' e.source = e.target := e.image_source_eq_target
  have I' : e' '' e'.source = e'.target := e'.image_source_eq_target
  rw [A, hs, I'] at I
  cases e; cases e'
  simp_all

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [trans_source'', trans_source'', ← target_eq he, ← hf.1]
    exact (he.symm'.eqOn.mono inter_subset_left).image_eq
  · intro x hx
    rw [trans_source] at hx
    simp [Function.comp_apply, PartialEquiv.coe_trans, (he.2 hx.1).symm, hf.2 hx.2]

        simp at h1
      · rw [removeNoneAux_none _ h2] at h1

name: decode_list_succ
statement:
@[simp]

    decode (α := List α) (succ v) =
      (· :: ·) <$> decode (α := α) v.unpair.1 <*> decode (α := List α) v.unpair.2
proof:
:=
  show decodeList (succ v) = _ by
    rcases e : unpair v with ⟨v₁, v₂⟩
    simp [decodeList, e]; rfl

name: length_le_encode
statement:

  | _ :: l => succ_le_succ <| (length_le_encode l).trans (right_le_pair _ _)

end List

name: denumerable_list_aux
statement:
theorem denumerable_list_aux : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a ∈ @decodeList α _ n, encodeList a = n
  | 0 => by rw [decodeList]; exact ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩
  | succ v => by
    rcases e : unpair v with ⟨v₁, v₂⟩
    have h
proof:
:= unpair_right_le v
    rw [e] at h
    rcases have : v₂ < succ v := lt_succ_of_le h
      denumerable_list_aux v₂ with
      ⟨a, h₁, h₂⟩
    rw [Option.mem_def] at h₁
    use ofNat α v₁ :: a
    simp [decodeList, e, h₂, h₁, encodeList, pair_eq_of_unpair_eq e]

proof:
:=
  ofNat_of_decode <|
    show decodeList (succ v) = _ by
      rcases e : unpair v with ⟨v₁, v₂⟩
      simp [decodeList, e, show decodeList v₂ = decode (α := List α) v₂ from rfl]

name: raise_lower'
statement:
theorem raise_lower' : ∀ {l n}, (∀ m ∈ l, n ≤ m) → List.SortedLT l → raise' (lower' l n) n = l
  | [], _, _, _ => rfl
  | m :: l, n, h₁, h₂ => by
    have : n ≤ m
proof:
:= h₁ _ List.mem_cons_self
    simp [raise', lower', Nat.sub_add_cancel this,
      raise_lower' (fun _ => List.rel_of_pairwise_cons h₂.pairwise : ∀ a ∈ l, m < a)
      h₂.pairwise.of_cons.sortedLT]

statement:
lemma image_swap_of_mem_of_notMem {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {s : Set α} {i j : α}
    (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∉ s) : s.image (swap i j) = insert j s \ {i}
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun a ↦ by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      obtain rfl | ne := eq_or_ne a i
      · rw [swap_apply_left]; exact ⟨.inl rfl, (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi hj).symm⟩
      · rw [swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem ha hj)]; exact ⟨.inr ha, ne⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl | has, hai⟩
      · exact ⟨i, hi, swap_apply_left ..⟩
      · exact ⟨a, has, swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hai (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem has hj)⟩

theorem preimage_piEquivPiSubtypeProd_symm_pi {α : Type*} {β : α → Type*} (p : α → Prop)

    (piEquivPiSubtypeProd p β).symm ⁻¹' pi univ s =

  ext ⟨f, g⟩
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_univ_pi, prodMk_mem_set_prod_eq, Subtype.forall, ← forall_and]

name: dite_comp_equiv_update
statement:
theorem dite_comp_equiv_update
    {α E : Type*} {β γ : Sort*} {p : α → Prop} [EquivLike E {x // p x} β]
    (e : E) (v : β → γ) (w : α → γ) (j : β) (x : γ)
    [DecidableEq β] [DecidableEq α] [∀ j, Decidable (p j)] :
    (fun i : α => if h : p i then (update v j x) (e ⟨i, h⟩) else w i) =
      update (fun i : α => if h : p i then v (e ⟨i, h⟩) else w i) (EquivLike.inv e j) x
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases h : p i
  · simp only [h, update_apply]
    aesop
  · grind

    (ec : γ₁ ≃ γ₂) (f : α₁ ↪ β₁) (g : β₁ ↪ γ₁) :
    Equiv.embeddingCongr ea ec (f.trans g) =
      (Equiv.embeddingCongr ea eb f).trans (Equiv.embeddingCongr eb ec g)

name: refl_toEmbedding
statement:
@[simp]
theorem refl_toEmbedding {α : Type*} : (Equiv.refl α).toEmbedding = Embedding.refl α

name: trans_toEmbedding
statement:

theorem trans_toEmbedding {α β γ : Type*} (e : α ≃ β) (f : β ≃ γ) :

name: subtypeOrLeftEmbedding_apply_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtypeOrLeftEmbedding_apply_left {p q : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    (x : { x // p x ∨ q x }) (hx : p x) :
    subtypeOrLeftEmbedding p q x = Sum.inl ⟨x, hx⟩

name: subtypeOrLeftEmbedding_apply_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtypeOrLeftEmbedding_apply_right {p q : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    (x : { x // p x ∨ q x }) (hx : ¬p x) :
    subtypeOrLeftEmbedding p q x = Sum.inr ⟨x, x.prop.resolve_left hx⟩

name: subtypeOrLeftEmbedding_apply
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem subtypeOrLeftEmbedding_apply {p q : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    (x : { x // p x ∨ q x }) :
    subtypeOrLeftEmbedding p q x =
      if h : p x then Sum.inl ⟨x, h⟩ else Sum.inr ⟨x, x.prop.resolve_left h⟩

name: Equiv.asEmbedding_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Equiv.asEmbedding_range {α β : Sort _} {p : β → Prop} (e : α ≃ Subtype p) :
    Set.range e.asEmbedding = Set.ofPred p
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x ↦ ⟨fun ⟨y, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ Subtype.coe_prop (e y), fun hs ↦ ⟨e.symm ⟨x, hs⟩, by simp⟩⟩

name: codRestrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codRestrict_apply {α β} (p) (f : α ↪ β) (H a) : codRestrict p f H a = ⟨f a, H a⟩

name: subtypeOrEquiv_symm_inl
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem subtypeOrEquiv_symm_inl (p q : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (h : Disjoint p q)
    (x : { x // p x }) : (subtypeOrEquiv p q h).symm (Sum.inl x) = ⟨x, Or.inl x.prop⟩

name: subtypeOrEquiv_symm_inr
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem subtypeOrEquiv_symm_inr (p q : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (h : Disjoint p q)
    (x : { x // q x }) : (subtypeOrEquiv p q h).symm (Sum.inr x) = ⟨x, Or.inr x.prop⟩

name: Function.Embedding.coe_sumSet

name: Function.Embedding.sumSet_preimage_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem Function.Embedding.sumSet_preimage_inl (h : Disjoint s t) :

name: Function.Embedding.sumSet_preimage_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem Function.Embedding.sumSet_preimage_inr (h : Disjoint s t) :
    .inr ⁻¹' Function.Embedding.sumSet h ⁻¹' r = r ∩ t

name: Function.Embedding.sumSet_range
statement:
@[simp] theorem Function.Embedding.sumSet_range {s t : Set α} (h : Disjoint s t) :

name: Function.Embedding.coe_sigmaSet
statement:

name: Function.Embedding.sigmaSet_preimage
Function.Embedding.sigmaSet_range
statement:
@[simp] theorem Function.Embedding.sigmaSet_range {s : ι → Set α}
    (h : Pairwise (Disjoint on s)) : Set.range (Function.Embedding.sigmaSet h) = ⋃ i, s i

name: iterate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_zero : f^[0] = id

name: iterate_zero_apply
statement: theorem iterate_zero_apply (x : α) : f^[0] x = x

name: iterate_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_succ (n : ℕ) : f^[n.succ] = f^[n] ∘ f

name: iterate_succ_apply
statement: theorem iterate_succ_apply (n : ℕ) (x : α) : f^[n.succ] x = f^[n] (f x)

name: iterate_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_id (n : ℕ) : (id : α → α)^[n] = id
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n rfl fun n ihn ↦ by rw [iterate_succ, ihn, id_comp]

name: iterate_add
statement:
theorem iterate_add (m : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ, f^[m + n] = f^[m] ∘ f^[n]
  | 0 => rfl
  | Nat.succ n => by rw [Nat.add_succ, iterate_succ, iterate_succ, iterate_add m n]; rfl

name: iterate_add_apply
statement: theorem iterate_add_apply (m n : ℕ) (x : α) : f^[m + n] x = f^[m] (f^[n] x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iterate_add f m n]
  rfl

name: iterate_one
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem iterate_one : f^[1] = f

name: iterate_mul
statement:
theorem iterate_mul (m : ℕ) : ∀ n, f^[m * n] = f^[m]^[n]
  | 0 => by simp only [Nat.mul_zero, iterate_zero]
  | n + 1 => by simp only [Nat.mul_succ, iterate_one, iterate_add, iterate_mul m n]

variable {f}

name: iterate_fixed
statement: theorem iterate_fixed {x} (h : f x = x) (n : ℕ) : f^[n] x = x
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n rfl fun n ihn ↦ by rw [iterate_succ_apply, h, ihn]

name: iterate_invariant
statement: theorem iterate_invariant {g : α → β} (h : g ∘ f = g) (n : ℕ) : g ∘ f^[n] = g
proof:
:= match n with
  | 0 => by rw [iterate_zero, comp_id]
  | m + 1 => by rwa [iterate_succ, ← comp_assoc, iterate_invariant h m]

name: Injective.iterate
statement: theorem Injective.iterate (Hinj : Injective f) (n : ℕ) : Injective f^[n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n injective_id fun _ ihn ↦ ihn.comp Hinj

name: Surjective.iterate
statement: theorem Surjective.iterate (Hsurj : Surjective f) (n : ℕ) : Surjective f^[n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n surjective_id fun _ ihn ↦ ihn.comp Hsurj

name: Bijective.iterate
statement: theorem Bijective.iterate (Hbij : Bijective f) (n : ℕ) : Bijective f^[n]

name: iterate_right
statement:
theorem iterate_right {f : α → β} {ga : α → α} {gb : β → β} (h : Semiconj f ga gb) (n : ℕ) :
    Semiconj f ga^[n] gb^[n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n id_right fun _ ihn ↦ ihn.comp_right h

name: iterate_left
statement:
theorem iterate_left {g : ℕ → α → α} (H : ∀ n, Semiconj f (g n) (g <| n + 1)) (n k : ℕ) :
    Semiconj f^[n] (g k) (g <| n + k)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing k with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.zero_add]
    exact id_left
  | succ n ihn =>
    rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
    exact (H k).trans (ihn (k + 1))

name: iterate_right
statement: theorem iterate_right (h : Commute f g) (n : ℕ) : Commute f g^[n]

name: iterate_left
statement: theorem iterate_left (h : Commute f g) (n : ℕ) : Commute f^[n] g

name: iterate_iterate
statement: theorem iterate_iterate (h : Commute f g) (m n : ℕ) : Commute f^[m] g^[n]

name: iterate_eq_of_map_eq
statement:
theorem iterate_eq_of_map_eq (h : Commute f g) (n : ℕ) {x} (hx : f x = g x) :
    f^[n] x = g^[n] x
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n rfl fun n ihn ↦ by
    simp only [iterate_succ_apply, hx, (h.iterate_left n).eq, ihn, ((refl g).iterate_right n).eq]

name: comp_iterate
statement: theorem comp_iterate (h : Commute f g) (n : ℕ) : (f ∘ g)^[n] = f^[n] ∘ g^[n]
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ihn =>
    funext x
    simp only [ihn, (h.iterate_right n).eq, iterate_succ, comp_apply]

name: iterate_self
statement: theorem iterate_self (n : ℕ) : Commute f^[n] f

name: self_iterate
statement: theorem self_iterate (n : ℕ) : Commute f f^[n]

name: iterate_iterate_self
statement: theorem iterate_iterate_self (m n : ℕ) : Commute f^[m] f^[n]

name: Semiconj
statement:
theorem Semiconj₂.iterate {f : α → α} {op : α → α → α} (hf : Semiconj₂ f op op) (n : ℕ) :
    Semiconj₂ f^[n] op op
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n (Semiconj₂.id_left op) fun _ ihn ↦ ihn.comp hf

statement: theorem iterate_succ' (n : ℕ) : f^[n.succ] = f ∘ f^[n]

statement: theorem iterate_succ_apply' (n : ℕ) (x : α) : f^[n.succ] x = f (f^[n] x)

name: comp_iterate_pred_of_pos
statement: theorem comp_iterate_pred_of_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : f ∘ f^[n.pred] = f^[n]

name: Iterate.rec_zero
statement:
theorem Iterate.rec_zero (motive : α → Sort*) {f : α → α} (app : ∀ a, motive a → motive (f a))
    {a : α} (arg : motive a) : Iterate.rec motive arg app 0 = arg

name: LeftInverse.iterate
statement:
theorem LeftInverse.iterate {g : α → α} (hg : LeftInverse g f) (n : ℕ) :
    LeftInverse g^[n] f^[n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn n (fun _ ↦ rfl) fun n ihn ↦ by
    rw [iterate_succ', iterate_succ]
    exact ihn.comp hg

name: RightInverse.iterate
statement:
theorem RightInverse.iterate {g : α → α} (hg : RightInverse g f) (n : ℕ) :
    RightInverse g^[n] f^[n]

name: iterate_comm
statement: theorem iterate_comm (f : α → α) (m n : ℕ) : f^[n]^[m] = f^[m]^[n]

name: iterate_commute
statement: theorem iterate_commute (m n : ℕ) : Commute (fun f : α → α ↦ f^[m]) fun f ↦ f^[n]
proof:
:=
  fun f ↦ iterate_comm f m n

name: iterate_add_eq_iterate
statement: lemma iterate_add_eq_iterate (hf : Injective f) : f^[m + n] a = f^[n] a ↔ f^[m] a = a

name: iterate_cancel
statement: lemma iterate_cancel (hf : Injective f) (ha : f^[m] a = f^[n] a) : f^[m - n] a = a

name: involutive_iff_iter_2_eq_id
statement: theorem involutive_iff_iter_2_eq_id {α} {f : α → α} : Involutive f ↔ f^[2] = id

name: foldl_const
statement:
theorem foldl_const (f : α → α) (a : α) (l : List β) :
    l.foldl (fun b _ ↦ f b) a = f^[l.length] a
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b l H => rw [length_cons, foldl, iterate_succ_apply, H]

name: foldr_const
statement:
theorem foldr_const (f : β → β) (b : β) : ∀ l : List α, l.foldr (fun _ ↦ f) b = f^[l.length] b
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by rw [length_cons, foldr, foldr_const f b l, iterate_succ_apply']

end List

/
Two maps `f g : α → α` commute if `f (g x) = g (f x)` for all `x : α`.
Given `h : Function.commute f g` and `a : α`, we have `h a : f (g a) = g (f a)` and
`h.comp_eq : f ∘ g = g ∘ f`.
-/

statement:
lemma hfunext {α α' : Sort u} {β : α → Sort v} {β' : α' → Sort v} {f : ∀ a, β a} {f' : ∀ a, β' a}
    (hα : α = α') (h : ∀ a a', a ≍ a' → f a ≍ f' a') : f ≍ f'
proof:
:= by
  subst hα
  have : ∀ a, f a ≍ f' a := fun a ↦ h a a (HEq.refl a)
  have : β = β' := by funext a; exact type_eq_of_heq (this a)
  subst this
  grind

theorem injective_comp_right_iff_surjective {γ : Type*} [Nontrivial γ] :
    Injective (fun g : β → γ ↦ g ∘ f) ↔ Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨not_imp_not.mp fun not_surj inj ↦ not_subsingleton γ ⟨fun c c' ↦ ?_⟩,
    (·.injective_comp_right)⟩
  have ⟨b₀, hb⟩ := not_forall.mp not_surj
  classical have := inj (a₁ := fun _ ↦ c) (a₂ := (if · = b₀ then c' else c)) ?_
  · simpa using congr_fun this b₀
  ext a; simp only [comp_apply, ite_eq_right fun h ↦ hb ⟨a, h⟩]

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨y, hpy, hy⟩ ↦
    let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf.surjective y
    ⟨x, by simpa [hx], fun z (hz : p (f z)) ↦ hf.injective <| hx.symm ▸ hy _ hz⟩,
    fun ⟨x, hpx, hx⟩ ↦
    ⟨f x, hpx, fun y hy ↦
      let ⟨z, hz⟩ := hf.surjective y
      hz ▸ congr_arg f (hx _ (by simpa [hz]))⟩⟩

name: not_surjective_Type
statement: theorem not_surjective_Type {α : Type u} (f : α → Type max u v) : ¬Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  intro hf
  let T : Type max u v := Sigma f
  cases hf (Set T) with | intro U hU =>
  let g : Set T → T := fun s ↦ ⟨U, cast hU.symm s⟩
  have hg : Injective g := by
    intro s t h
    suffices cast hU (g s).2 = cast hU (g t).2 by
      simp only [g, cast_cast, cast_eq] at this
      assumption
    · congr
  exact cantor_injective g hg

name: Injective.isPartialInv
statement:
theorem Injective.isPartialInv {α β} {f : α → β} (I : Injective f) : IsPartialInv f (partialInv f)
  | a, b =>
  ⟨fun h =>
    open scoped Classical in
    have hpi : partialInv f b = if h : ∃ a, f a = b then some (Classical.choose h) else none
proof:
:=
      rfl
    if h' : ∃ a, f a = b
    then by rw [hpi, dite_eq_left h'] at h
            injection h with h
            subst h
            apply Classical.choose_spec h'
    else by rw [hpi, dite_eq_right h'] at h; contradiction,
  fun e => e ▸ have h : ∃ a', f a' = f a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
              (dite_eq_left h).trans (congr_arg _ (I <| Classical.choose_spec h))⟩

lemma update_congr {β : Sort*}
    {f₁ f₂ : α → β} (hf : f₁ = f₂) {a'₁ a'₂ : α} (ha' : a'₁ = a'₂)
    {v₁ v₂ : β} (hv : v₁ = v₂) {a₁ a₂ : α} (ha : a₁ = a₂) :
    Function.update f₁ a'₁ v₁ a₁ = Function.update f₂ a'₂ v₂ a₂

name: forall_update_iff
statement:
lemma forall_update_iff (f : ∀ a, β a) {a : α} {b : β a} (p : ∀ a, β a → Prop) :
    (∀ x, p x (update f a b x)) ↔ p a b ∧ ∀ x, x ≠ a → p x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← and_forall_ne a, update_self]
  simp +contextual

name: exists_update_iff
statement:
theorem exists_update_iff (f : ∀ a, β a) {a : α} {b : β a} (p : ∀ a, β a → Prop) :
    (∃ x, p x (update f a b x)) ↔ p a b ∨ ∃ x ≠ a, p x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_forall_not, forall_update_iff f fun a b ↦ ¬p a b]
  simp [-not_and, not_and_or]

name: update_eq_iff
statement:
theorem update_eq_iff {a : α} {b : β a} {f g : ∀ a, β a} :
    update f a b = g ↔ b = g a ∧ ∀ x ≠ a, f x = g x
proof:
:=
  funext_iff.trans <| forall_update_iff _ fun x y ↦ y = g x

name: eq_update_iff
statement:
theorem eq_update_iff {a : α} {b : β a} {f g : ∀ a, β a} :
    g = update f a b ↔ g a = b ∧ ∀ x ≠ a, g x = f x
proof:
:=
  funext_iff.trans <| forall_update_iff _ fun x y ↦ g x = y

lemma rec_update {ι κ : Sort*} {α : κ → Sort*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ]

    (recursor : ((i : ι) → α (ctor i)) → ((i : κ) → α i))

name: _root_.Pi.map_injective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Pi.map_injective
    {ι : Sort*} {α β : ι → Sort*} [∀ i, Nonempty (α i)] {f : ∀ i, α i → β i} :
    Injective (Pi.map f) ↔ ∀ i, Injective (f i) where
  mp h i x y hxy
proof:
:= by
    classical
    have : Inhabited (∀ i, α i) := ⟨fun _ => Classical.choice inferInstance⟩

name: Injective.extend_comp
statement:
theorem Injective.extend_comp {α₁ α₂ α₃ : Sort*} {f₁₂ : α₁ → α₂} (h₁₂ : Function.Injective f₁₂)
    {f₂₃ : α₂ → α₃} (h₂₃ : Function.Injective f₂₃) (g : α₁ → γ) (e' : α₃ → γ) :
    extend (f₂₃ ∘ f₁₂) g e' = extend f₂₃ (extend f₁₂ g (e' ∘ f₂₃)) e'
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  by_cases h₃ : ∃ b, f₂₃ b = a
  · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := h₃
    rw [Injective.extend_apply h₂₃]
    by_cases h₂ : ∃ c, f₁₂ c = b
    · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h₂
      rw [h₁₂.extend_apply]
      exact (h₂₃.comp h₁₂).extend_apply _ _ _
    · rw [extend_apply' _ _ _ h₂, extend_apply', comp_apply]
      exact fun h ↦ h₂ (Exists.casesOn h fun c hc ↦ Exists.intro c (h₂₃ hc))
  · rw [extend_apply' _ _ _ h₃, extend_apply']
    exact fun h ↦ h₃ (Exists.casesOn h fun c hc ↦ Exists.intro (f₁₂ c) (hc))

name: factorsThrough_iff
statement: lemma factorsThrough_iff (g : α → γ) [Nonempty γ] : g.FactorsThrough f ↔ ∃ (e : β → γ), g = e ∘ f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hf => ⟨extend f g (const β (Classical.arbitrary γ)),
      funext (fun x => by simp only [comp_apply, hf.extend_apply])⟩,
  fun h _ _ hf => by rw [Classical.choose_spec h, comp_apply, comp_apply, hf]⟩

name: surjective_comp_right_iff_injective
statement:
theorem surjective_comp_right_iff_injective {γ : Type*} [Nontrivial γ] :
    Surjective (fun g : β → γ ↦ g ∘ f) ↔ Injective f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨not_imp_not.mp fun not_inj surj ↦ not_subsingleton γ ⟨fun c c' ↦ ?_⟩,
    (·.surjective_comp_right)⟩
  simp only [Injective, not_forall] at not_inj
  have ⟨a₁, a₂, eq, ne⟩ := not_inj
  have ⟨f, hf⟩ := surj (if · = a₂ then c else c')
  have h₁ := congr_fun hf a₁
  have h₂ := congr_fun hf a₂
  simp only [comp_apply, ite_eq_right ne, reduceIte] at h₁ h₂
  rw [← h₁, eq, h₂]

name: Bijective.comp_right

     by simp only [comp_assoc g _ f, (leftInverse_surjInv hf).comp_eq_id, comp_id]⟩⟩

statement:
lemma forall_existsUnique_iff {r : α → β → Prop} :
    (∀ a, ∃! b, r a b) ↔ ∃ f : α → β, ∀ {a b}, r a b ↔ f a = b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun a ↦ (h a).choose, fun hr ↦ ?_, fun h' ↦ h' ▸ ?_⟩
    exacts [((h _).choose_spec.2 _ hr).symm, (h _).choose_spec.1]
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    simp [hf]

proof:

  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨f, _, hf⟩ ↦ forall_existsUnique_iff'.2 ⟨f, hf⟩⟩
  rcases forall_existsUnique_iff'.1 h with ⟨f, rfl : r = _⟩
  exact ⟨f, symm_apply_eq_iff.1 ‹_›, rfl⟩

name: sequence_mono_nat
statement:
theorem sequence_mono_nat {r : β → β → Prop} {f : α → β} (hf : Directed r f) (n : ℕ) :
    r (f (hf.sequence f n)) (f (hf.sequence f (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [Directed.sequence]
  generalize hf.sequence f n = p
  rcases (decode n : Option α) with - | a
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec (hf p p)).1
  · exact (Classical.choose_spec (hf p a)).1

proof:
:= by
  simp only [Directed.sequence, encodek]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (hf _ a)).2

name: iUnion_decode
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem iUnion_decode₂_cases {f : β → Set α} {C : Set α → Prop} (H0 : C ∅) (H1 : ∀ b, C (f b)) {n} :
    C (⋃ b ∈ decode₂ β n, f b)
proof:
:=
  match decode₂ β n with
  | none => by
    simp only [Option.mem_def, iUnion_of_empty, iUnion_empty, reduceCtorEq]
    apply H0
  | some b => by
    convert! H1 b
    simp

name: iUnion_decode
statement:
theorem iUnion_decode₂_disjoint_on {f : β → Set α} (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on f)) :
    Pairwise (Disjoint on fun i => ⋃ b ∈ decode₂ β i, f b)
proof:
:= by
  rintro i j ij
  refine disjoint_left.mpr fun x => ?_
  suffices ∀ a, encode a = i → x ∈ f a → ∀ b, encode b = j → x ∉ f b by simpa [decode₂_eq_some]
  rintro a rfl ha b rfl hb
  exact (hd (mt (congr_arg encode) ij)).le_bot ⟨ha, hb⟩

  · simp only [not_nonempty_iff] at hβ

name: coprime_mul_succ
statement: lemma coprime_mul_succ {n m a} (ha : m - n ∣ a) : Coprime (n * a + 1) (m * a + 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p pp hn hm => by
    have : p ∣ (m - n) * a := by
      simpa [Nat.succ_sub_succ, ← Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib] using
        Nat.dvd_sub hm hn
    have : p ∣ a := by
      rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul pp).mp this with (hp | hp)
      · exact Nat.dvd_trans hp ha
      · exact hp
    apply pp.ne_one
    simpa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using Nat.dvd_sub hn (this.mul_left n)

name: coprimes_lt
statement: private lemma coprimes_lt (a : Fin m → ℕ) (i) : a i < coprimes a i
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : a i < supOfSeq a :=
    Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mpr (le_max_of_le_right <| Finset.le_sup (by simp))
  have h₂ : supOfSeq a ≤ (i + 1) * (supOfSeq a)! + 1 :=
    le_trans (self_le_factorial _) (le_trans (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left (supOfSeq a)! (succ_pos i))
      (le_add_right _ _))
  simpa only [coprimes] using lt_of_lt_of_le h₁ h₂

name: pairwise_coprime_coprimes
statement: private lemma pairwise_coprime_coprimes (a : Fin m → ℕ) : Pairwise (Coprime on coprimes a)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  wlog! ltij : i < j
  · exact (this a hij.symm (lt_of_le_of_ne ltij hij.symm)).symm
  unfold Function.onFun coprimes
  have hja : j < supOfSeq a := lt_of_lt_of_le j.prop (le_succ_of_le (le_max_left _ _))
  exact coprime_mul_succ
    (Nat.dvd_factorial (by lia)
      (by simpa only [Nat.succ_sub_succ] using le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (sub_le j i) hja)))

name: beta_unbeta_coe
statement: lemma beta_unbeta_coe (l : List ℕ) (i : Fin l.length) : beta (unbeta l) i = l[i]
proof:
:= by
  simpa [beta, unbeta, coprimes] using mod_eq_of_modEq
    ((chineseRemainderOfFinset (l[·]) (coprimes (l[·])) Finset.univ
      (by simp [coprimes])
      (by simpa using Set.pairwise_univ.mpr (pairwise_coprime_coprimes _))).prop i (by simp))
    (coprimes_lt _ _)

name: Fin.snoc_eq_cons_rotate
statement:
theorem Fin.snoc_eq_cons_rotate {α : Type*} (v : Fin n → α) (a : α) :
    @Fin.snoc _ (fun _ => α) v a = fun i => @Fin.cons _ (fun _ => α) a v (finRotate _ i)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨i, h⟩
  by_cases h' : i < n
  · rw [finRotate_of_lt h', Fin.snoc, Fin.cons, dite_eq_left h']
    rfl
  · have h'' : n = i := by
      simp only [not_lt] at h'
      exact (Nat.eq_of_le_of_lt_succ h' h).symm
    subst h''
    rw [finRotate_last', Fin.snoc, Fin.cons, dite_eq_right (lt_irrefl _)]
    rfl

name: finRotate_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finRotate_apply (i : Fin n) : haveI
proof:
:= i.neZero; finRotate n i = i + 1 := by
  match n with
  | 0 => exact i.elim0
  | 1 => exact @Subsingleton.elim (Fin 1) _ _ _
  | n + 2 =>
    obtain rfl | h := Fin.eq_or_lt_of_le i.le_last
    · simp [finRotate_last]
    · cases i
      simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_last] at h
      simp [finRotate_of_lt h, Fin.add_def, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.succ_lt_succ h)]

name: finRotate_succ_apply
statement:
@[deprecated finRotate_apply (since := "2026-03-29")]
theorem finRotate_succ_apply (i : Fin (n + 1)) : finRotate (n + 1) i = i + 1

name: finRotate_apply_zero
statement: theorem finRotate_apply_zero : finRotate n.succ 0 = 1

name: coe_finRotate_of_ne_last
statement:
theorem coe_finRotate_of_ne_last {i : Fin n.succ} (h : i ≠ Fin.last n) :
    (finRotate (n + 1) i : ℕ) = i + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finRotate_apply]
  have : (i : ℕ) < n := Fin.val_lt_last h
  exact Fin.val_add_one_of_lt this

name: coe_finRotate
statement:
theorem coe_finRotate (i : Fin n.succ) :
    (finRotate n.succ i : ℕ) = if i = Fin.last n then (0 : ℕ) else i + 1

name: lt_finRotate_iff_ne_last
statement:
theorem lt_finRotate_iff_ne_last (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    i < finRotate _ i ↔ i ≠ Fin.last n

name: lt_finRotate_iff_ne_neg_one
statement:
theorem lt_finRotate_iff_ne_neg_one [NeZero n] (i : Fin n) :
    i < finRotate _ i ↔ i ≠ -1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  rw [lt_finRotate_iff_ne_last, ne_eq, not_iff_not, ← Fin.neg_last, neg_neg]

name: finRotate_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finRotate_symm_apply (i : Fin n) : haveI
proof:
:= i.neZero; (finRotate _).symm i = i - 1 := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero i.pos.ne'
  apply (finRotate n.succ).symm_apply_eq.mpr
  rw [finRotate_apply, sub_add_cancel]

name: finRotate_succ_symm_apply
statement:
@[deprecated finRotate_symm_apply (since := "2026-03-29")]
lemma finRotate_succ_symm_apply [NeZero n] (i : Fin n) : (finRotate _).symm i = i - 1

name: coe_finRotate_symm_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma coe_finRotate_symm_of_ne_zero [NeZero n] {i : Fin n} (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    ((finRotate _).symm i : ℕ) = i - 1

name: finRotate_symm_lt_iff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finRotate_symm_lt_iff_ne_zero [NeZero n] (i : Fin n) :
    (finRotate _).symm i < i ↔ i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  refine ⟨ne_zero_of_lt, fun hi ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Fin.lt_def, coe_finRotate_symm_of_ne_zero hi]
  exact sub_lt (zero_lt_of_ne_zero <| Fin.val_ne_zero_iff.mpr hi) zero_lt_one

name: finCycle_eq_finRotate_iterate
statement: lemma finCycle_eq_finRotate_iterate {k : Fin n} : finCycle k = (finRotate n)^[k.1]
proof:
:= by
  match n with
  | 0 => exact k.elim0
  | n + 1 =>
    ext i; induction k using Fin.induction with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [Fin.val_eq_val, Fin.val_castSucc] at ih
      rw [Fin.val_succ, Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply, ← ih, finRotate_apply,
        finCycle_apply, finCycle_apply, add_assoc, Fin.coeSucc_eq_succ]
